brief: A one-two from the guard: a left jab that lands on the target's head at 0.5 s, back to the guard, then a right cross on the chin at about 1.03 s; both feet stay planted.
notes: Fighter 2 is a still target facing the hero. 30 fps.

right fist touches fighter 2 chin at 1.03 s +-3 f
